correctness.rationale: Orthogonality reduces every coefficient to a three-difference sum. For V4 each nontrivial leaf frequency supports one difference and gives the exact rank. For Z4 the disjoint difference-2 and odd-difference supports, and exact conjugate phases, imply the even/odd cancellation and magnitude classes. Binomial summation gives both ranks; all maxima/minima are achieved. Two independently implemented exact Gaussian-integer enumerators passed for n=1..4 and n=1..8, respectively. Exact hypotheses and normalization are recorded in RESULT.md.
